features: Persistent de-duplicated offer index across full-search runs
Active, new and historical offer state
Automatic inactive marking when a previously seen offer is no longer returned for its cartridge

Sorting by total price, newest offer or cartridge
Direct offer links and source badges
Legacy saved search migration into the offer index
Horizontal overflow prevention for navigation, filters, cards and links
Fehlend and Wünsche remain retired from the visible GUI
